name: Indian Island Golf Course

dtm.source: NYS DEM_2024_Long_Island (NYS ITS Geospatial Services / USGS): 1 m hydro-flattened bare-earth DEM from the 2024 Long Island lidar; NAD83 / UTM 18N (EPSG:26918), NAVD88 (GEOID18) metres; exported by the developer 2026-10-19 (GitHub release data-indian-island, indian_island_dem_2024.tif), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/clip_raster.py

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (1,548 x 612 m) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,792 m east-west (~122 m each side), 1,024 m north-south (~206 m each side)

scorecard_source: Suffolk County Parks scorecard PDF (indianisland-scorecard.pdf, supplied by the developer 2026-10-19, GitHub release data-indian-island): yardages, pars, stroke index, ratings/slopes (Blue 71.5/126, same as the county website). Built from the Blue tees only (developer, 2026-10-19); White, Gold and Red are on the card but not built
attribution: Elevation: NYS ITS Geospatial Services / USGS (2024 Long Island lidar DEM)
Imagery used for tracing: NYS ITS Geospatial Services statewide orthoimagery
notes: Phase 1 decisions (developer, 2026-10-19): Blue tees only; county ratings; course chat traces the holes OSM lacks (9, 10 green and fairway, 11-18) from the NYS orthoimagery and DEM into proposed/ for approval; Peconic River and Flanders Bay red; the inlet pond yellow where played over, red where alongside; Route 105 out of bounds, Riverside Drive and inner roads free relief; police station and sewage plant not out of bounds; new bayside theme after a side-by-side. Wind 2-12 mph is the course chat's choice (open bay, between Oswego 1-7 and Highland 3-14).
